title: herniaria incana subsp. alpina
intro: Herniaria incana subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Rupturewort, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Rupturewort are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
